Name: Crops In more seasons
Author: TF712
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds crops to more seasons including a few to winter[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install Content Patcher.
3. Download and unzip this mod.
4. Place the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
5. Launch the game using SMAPI.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Allows more crops to be planted in more seasons[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI
Content Patcher[/color][/size]
